currentWork: MarkerPDF is supervised as a native PHP searchable-PDF parser/converter plus supplied-boundary review pipeline. This isolated patch covers action-review xref Prev chains in incremental updates whose latest xref stream advertises a forward or invalid /Prev offset: the native parser falls back to the latest earlier xref section before repairing current action rows, so WordPress link promotion sees current URI/additional action objects and excludes stale JavaScript/action data. No Python, CUDA, OCR, model execution, multiprocessing, raster rendering, PDF action execution, decryption/password validation, or external PDF tools run.
blocker: No GPU/model execution will be run for markerPDF under current user direction. Therefore live OCR for scanned PDFs, Surya layout/reading-order/OCR/table-cell models, Texify equation recognition, Torch/model batching, Streamlit/FastAPI model workers, page-pixel visual table recognition, and exact upstream model benchmark parity are intentionally unavailable. The continuous refill watchdog is active for markerPDF/Pandoc workers; remaining in-scope markerPDF work is native searchable-PDF behavior and supplied-boundary conversion/review.
